subject: 🏃 Thursday — 6 mi Easy (Wk 9)
html:
Tomorrow: 6 mi Easy — Z2 by RPE (conversational). No H10 in BC, so run entirely by feel — you should be able to hold a conversation the whole way. BC roads or trails, whatever's convenient. Pre-run: do what you can of the activation (hip CARs, glute bridges, bodyweight lateral walks) — skip banded exercises if you don't have bands.

Focus cue: genuinely easy. Yesterday's threshold session was strong — 6 reps at 7:04–7:33, consistent pacing by feel alone, knee 1/5. That quality is banked. Today's job is pure recovery between that and Friday's bodyweight strength + PT. Don't let the legs talk you into turning it into a tempo; conversational effort the entire way.

Hamstring check: you noted a hint of right-hamstring tightness after yesterday's reps (resolved by reporting time). If it shows up again early in the run, keep it strictly easy and shorten to 4 mi rather than push through. Two faint appearances after quality sessions (Jun 24, Jul 1) is a pattern worth respecting, even though it hasn't been actionable yet.

Context: Week 9, Phase 3 — Peak Volume & Power. 24 days to the SF Marathon. This is the biggest-volume week of the build (~44 mi), and Sunday's 16-miler with 8 mi at MP is the centerpiece — the first real test of fueling at effort since the Presidio fix. Protect your legs for that. Tomorrow is a deposit into Sunday's freshness bank, not a withdrawal.

Prep: Hydrate well tonight, easy dinner, get to bed at a reasonable hour. No special fueling needed for a 6-mi easy — just water if you want it.
